title: WAON: Large-Scale and High-Quality Japanese Image-Text Pair Dataset for Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot image classification performance on Japanese cultural benchmarks (WAON-Bench and Recruit) to measure how well models understand Japanese culture compared to Western-centric datasets. The study also applies t-SNE to image embeddings to analyze the semantic distribution and potential biases within the dataset's cultural categories.

Comparing model performance on zero-shot image classification and image-text retrieval tasks (e.g., XM3600) to demonstrate the performance drop caused by relying on translated English captions rather than native Japanese image-text pairs.
